cohort: Singleton fetuses without structural abnormalities on second-trimester ultrasound
finding: Computerized CTG parameters evolve throughout pregnancy, with increases in LTV, STV, accelerations, and contractions, while FHR baseline and decelerations decrease; high inter-fetal variability and considerable intra-fetal consistency suggest potential value of individualized assessment.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly higher in cases with a decrease in average STV throughout gestation.
